summary: An article describes a pig butchering crypto scam where victims receive random text messages build rapport over messaging apps and are later directed to deposit funds into fake crypto investment platforms. Scammers use impersonation fake identities and staged wealth to gain trust before introducing fraudulent investment websites.
user_mistake: Responding to unsolicited messages and moving conversation to third party messaging apps
prevention: Block unsolicited investment outreach messages / Refuse to deposit funds into private messaging investment schemes
